title: Family (f) Bernoulli: incorrect numerator listing and a_2 value

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Factual error in Section (f).**

The solution lists the absolute numerators of $B_{2m}$ as '$1,1,1,1,1,691,7,3617,\dots$' and states the sorted distinct sequence starts with $a_2=3$.

The correct numerators $|\mathrm{num}(B_{2m})|$ are $1,1,1,1,5,691,7,3617,\dots$ — i.e. $B_{10}=5/66$ has numerator $5$, not $1$; there is no run of five $1$'s. The sorted set of distinct values begins $1,5,7,691,3617,\dots$, so $a_1=1,\ a_2=5$ (not $3$).

The conclusion $M=1$ (since $a_2\ne2$) is unaffected, and the leading asymptotic $N(n)\sim\log n/(2\log\log n)$ is consistent with $\log(\mathrm{num}\,B_{2m})\sim 2m\log m$ (verified). But the displayed data must be corrected, and the $k(n)$ asymptotic is subject to the separate $\log^*$ issue.
